```{r, data}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/pathogenwatch/curated/pathogenwatch_data.RDS",
  c(
    "ng_sample_metadata",
    "ng_meta",
    "pathogenwatch_isolate_data",
    "resistance_variables",
    "mutation_variables",
    "chosen_genome_ids"
  )
)
load_processed_data(
  "./data/phylogeny/curated/phylogeny_profile_data.RDS",
  c("tree", "profiles_350", "ng_STs", "genome_groups")
)
```

```{r}
# Major ST
major_sts <- genome_groups %>% subset(st_class == "Major ST") %>% .$ST %>% unique
 

# Merge data
overall_data <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  mutate(study = "Overall")
overall_data$major_ST <- overall_data$sequence_type %in% major_sts

chosen_data <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(is_chosen) %>%
  mutate(study = "Chosen")
chosen_data$major_ST <-  chosen_data$sequence_type %in% major_sts

comparison_data <- bind_rows(overall_data, chosen_data)
```

# Temporal distribution
```{r}
paste0("Temporal distribution: ")
comparison_data$decade_2010 <- comparison_data$collection_decade == 2010
temporal_comparison <- comparison_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_decade)) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  summarise(
    genomes_with_year = n(),
    genomes_in_2010s = sum(collection_decade == 2010),
    percent_in_2010s = 100 * mean(collection_decade == 2010),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

temporal_comparison %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Temporal comparison p-value: ",fisher.test(
  table(comparison_data$collection_decade, comparison_data$study),
  simulate.p.value = TRUE
)$p.value)

paste0("Temporal comparison (2010s) p-value: ",fisher.test(
  table(comparison_data$decade_2010, comparison_data$study),
  simulate.p.value = TRUE
)$p.value)
```

# Continent differences
```{r}
comparison_data$americas <- ifelse(is.na(comparison_data$collection_continent),NA,ifelse(comparison_data$collection_continent=="Americas",T,F))
continent_comparison <- comparison_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_continent)) %>%
  count(study, collection_continent) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percent = 100 * n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

table(comparison_data$collection_continent,comparison_data$study,dnn= c("Collection continent","Study"))

continent_comparison %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Continent comparison p-value: ",fisher.test(
  table(comparison_data$collection_continent, comparison_data$study),
  simulate.p.value = TRUE
)$p.value)

paste0("Dominant content (Americas) p-value: ",fisher.test(
  table(comparison_data$americas, comparison_data$study),
  simulate.p.value = TRUE
)$p.value)
```

# Sequence type distribution differences
```{r}
sequence_type_comparison <- tibble(
  global_sequence_types = n_distinct(overall_data$sequence_type, na.rm = TRUE),
  chosen_sequence_types = n_distinct(chosen_data$sequence_type, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  mutate(percent_represented = 100 * chosen_sequence_types / global_sequence_types)

sequence_type_comparison %>% favorite_kable()

# Differences overall distribution 
paste0("P-value differences across all STs: ",  fisher.test(
  table(comparison_data$sequence_type, comparison_data$study),
  simulate.p.value = TRUE
)$p.value)

# Major ST data
comparison_data %>% group_by(study) %>% summarise(total_isolates = n(), major_ST_ct = sum(major_ST),major_ST_perc = major_ST_ct / total_isolates*100) 

paste0("P-value differences across major ST vs minor STs: ",  fisher.test(
  table(comparison_data$major_ST, comparison_data$study),
  simulate.p.value = TRUE
)$p.value)
```

# Resistance distribution
```{r}
resistance_distribution <- comparison_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(resistance_variables),
    names_to = "antibiotic",
    values_to = "prediction"
  ) %>%
  group_by(antibiotic, study) %>%
  summarise(
    nonsusceptible = sum(prediction != "NOT_FOUND"),
    total = n(),
    percent = 100 * mean(prediction != "NOT_FOUND"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

resistance_p_values <- map_dfr(
  resistance_variables,
  function(antibiotic) {
    nonsusceptible <- comparison_data[[antibiotic]] != "NOT_FOUND"
    tibble(
      antibiotic = antibiotic,
      fisher_p = fisher.test(
        table(nonsusceptible, comparison_data$study)
      )$p.value
    )
  }
)

resistance_comparison <- resistance_distribution %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = study,
    values_from = c(nonsusceptible, total, percent)
  ) %>%
  left_join(resistance_p_values, by = "antibiotic") %>%
  arrange(match(antibiotic, resistance_variables))

resistance_comparison %>% favorite_kable()
```

# Mutation distribution
```{r}
mutation_distribution <- comparison_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(mutation_variables),
    names_to = "locus",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(present = as.numeric(as.character(value)) > 0) %>%
  group_by(locus, study) %>%
  summarise(
    present = sum(present),
    total = n(),
    percent = 100 * mean(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mutation_p_values <- map_dfr(
  mutation_variables,
  function(locus) {
    present <- as.numeric(as.character(comparison_data[[locus]])) > 0
    tibble(
      locus = locus,
      fisher_p = fisher.test(
        table(present, comparison_data$study)
      )$p.value
    )
  }
)

mutation_comparison <- mutation_distribution %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = study,
    values_from = c(present, total, percent)
  ) %>%
  left_join(mutation_p_values, by = "locus") %>%
  arrange(fisher_p)

mutation_comparison %>% favorite_kable()
```
